integrity: Algebraic proof of all-order census and richness law; independent finite exhaustive support/eigenvalue checker included, not itself an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform one-way inhibition, independently retained edges, n>=3, noncritical positive coupling. Hurwitz-stable equilibria only; absence of Hurwitz equilibria does not exclude recurrent dynamics. Known cyclic spectral stability criteria and classical Lotka–Volterra theory are not claimed as novel.
title: Exact stable-state census for independently thinned directed ecological cycles
